Native functional mixed-effects workflow with an optional frozen Python 1.2 W3 scientific record

etr_run_functional_mixed_effects_workflow.Rd

Runs an explicitly declared functional Gaussian spline mixed-effects analysis without preprocessing, automatic covariance selection, optimizer fallback or implicit model selection. Source mode preserves the frozen Python 1.2 W3 scientific workflow envelope and coefficient-frame columns, but the actual optimizer is native R nlme, rather than statsmodels MixedLM. The strict source config therefore declares method="nlme::lme", not an impersonated Python optimizer method. The reported elapsed time covers the one native fit-and-audit operation. Python error classes, runtime object identity, literal report wording, full numerical optimizer and boundary-domain parity remain unverified.

Usage

etr_run_functional_mixed_effects_workflow(
    trajectories, design, config, strict_source_record = FALSE)

Arguments

trajectories

Complete native functional trajectories on a shared time grid.

design

Curve-aligned native data frame of declared scalar predictors.

config

Named configuration. Use estimator="native_joint_bspline_gaussian" for a genuine Gaussian spline likelihood fit with explicit predictors, participant_column, dimension, basis controls and method="nlme::lme". The separate legacy moments estimator remains available only outside strict source mode.

strict_source_record

If TRUE, require the native likelihood optimizer and emit the nine ordered frozen Python FunctionalMixedEffectsWorkflowResult scientific fields, a fifteen-field scientific config, one measured native fit step, fourteen analyst decisions, six provenance declarations, a coefficient table and an honest R-native report. This does not supply Python statsmodels class or optimizer identity.

Value

An explicit native functional mixed-effects workflow. In strict mode, a etr_functional_mixed_effects_w3_scientific_workflow record with genuine Gaussian fixed/random effect fit, timed execution and source-ordered W3 scientific fields.
